basis: The chart's legend explicitly maps color to incidence: dark burgundy (Low, 0) to pale yellow (High, 100). Texas (TX) is pale yellow, indicating the highest incidence among the three options. Washington (WA) is dark burgundy, indicating the lowest incidence. Colorado (CO) is dark red, which is between dark burgundy and pale yellow, indicating an intermediate incidence level. Since the workflow requires selecting the jurisdiction with the highest incidence, and TX is the only one at the 'High' level (100), it is the correct choice.
option_label: Open Texas (TX) incidence profile for follow-up routing
